lines.zh: : 完了。

lines.en: : Bro. Bro. Fuck. Okay, here’s what you’ve gotta do.
lines.zh: : 兄弟。兄弟。操。冷静，现在你得这么办。

lines.en: : I have made a horrible mistake.
lines.zh: : 我犯下了可怕的错误。

lines.en: : No, bro, it’s okay. You’ve just gotta bury the sock inside of me.
lines.zh: : 不，兄弟，没事的。你只要把袜子埋进我土里就行。

lines.en: : But what if you get pregnant? I can’t afford to take care of a sapling.
lines.zh: : 可你要是怀孕了怎么办？我可养不起一棵树苗。

lines.en: : Bro, don’t worry. You think this is the first time you’ve buried a cum sock inside of me? I guarantee you there are at least like five more down there right now.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，别慌。你当这是第一次把精华袜埋进我身体里？我保证，下面现在至少还埋着五只。

lines.en: : Are you sure it is okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定没问题？

lines.en: : Bro, yes. Socks disappear all the fucking time. Where the hell you think they go?
lines.zh: : 兄弟，确定。袜子无时无刻不在失踪。你以为它们都去哪了？

lines.en: : I’ve never really thought about it.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过这个问题。

lines.en: : Good. Stop thinking altogether.
lines.zh: : 很好。干脆什么都别想。

lines.en: : Erase your mind and wipe the residual cum from a bad decision off of your hands. Life goes on.
lines.zh: : 清空你的脑子，把错误决定残留的精华从手上擦掉。生活还要继续。

lines.en: : Bury the fucking sock, bro.
lines.zh: : 把那该死的袜子埋了，兄弟。

lines.en: : Okay. But only because I trust you.
lines.zh: : 好。看在我信你的份上。

lines.en: scene black
I slide my fingers into the dirt.
lines.zh: 我把手指插进土里。

lines.en: It gets inside of my fingernails and reminds me of something I don’t like very much.
lines.zh: 泥土钻进指甲缝，让我想起一件我相当不喜欢的事。

lines.en: scene warble15
: Thanks again for meeting up with me so early, you two. I’ll make it up to you at the next manga club meeting.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你们俩这么早陪我出来。下次漫画社活动我请客补上。

lines.en: : Your debt matters not, moonchild! For it falls upon the party to lighten the burden of its leader.
lines.zh: : 你的债不重要，月之子！为队长减轻重担，本就是队伍的职责！

lines.en: : As the president of the manga club, wouldn’t you be the leader, Molly?
lines.zh: : 身为漫画社社长，你不就是队长吗，Molly？

lines.en: : I am the leader of the guild. Ami is the one who formed today’s party.
lines.zh: : 我是公会长。今天的队伍是 Ami 组的。

lines.en: : What we did here today was no different from carrying her through Ragefire Chasm a few times.
lines.zh: : 我们今天做的事，跟带她刷几次怒焰裂谷没什么区别。

lines.en: : Is that another WoW thing?
lines.zh: : 这又是什么魔兽梗？

lines.en: : Guh. You are so lucky I can’t vote to kick in real life.
lines.zh: : 唔。幸好现实里不能投票踢人，算你走运。

lines.en: scene warble16
: Hmm...hmmm...hmmmm~
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯嗯……嗯嗯嗯~

lines.en: : I wonder if I should bother making breakfast today?
lines.zh: : 我在想，今天还要不要做早餐？

lines.en: : I’m not really hungry and Sensei will probably be asleep for another hour or two, so...
lines.zh: : 我不太饿，Sensei 大概还要再睡一两个小时，所以……

lines.en: : Mmmm...yeah. I’ll make it anyway. And if he’s not hungry when he wakes up, we can just eat it for dinner or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……算了。我还是做吧。他醒来要是不饿，就留到晚饭再吃什么的。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m home...
lines.zh: : 我回来了……

lines.en: scene warble17
: Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: : Can you speak?
lines.zh: : 你会说话吗？

lines.en: : What is your favorite bug?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢的虫子是什么？

lines.en: : The marsh warbler lives off of a diet of insects and also occasionally eats things like spiders and snails.
lines.zh: : 湿地苇莺以昆虫为主食，偶尔也吃蜘蛛、蜗牛之类的东西。

lines.en: : While most of its diet is plucked from vegetation, it sometimes snatches bugs out of thin air or off the ground when it is feeling less acrobatic.
lines.zh: : 它的食物大多从草木间拾取，但懒得杂耍的时候，也会从半空或地面直接抓虫。

lines.en: : It is a medium sized warbler who mimics the calls of many other birds, hoping to lure them into its general vicinity so it can use its narrow, pointed beak to prod at their respective cloacae.
lines.zh: : 它是一种中型莺，擅长模仿许多其他鸟类的叫声，想把它们骗到自己附近，好用窄而尖的喙去戳它们的泄殖腔。

lines.en: : There are estimated to be between 10 and 27 million marsh warblers in existence. Their eggs are not normally eaten by humans, but they could be if a human decided to eat them.
lines.zh: : 据估计，世上的湿地苇莺在一千万到两千七百万只之间。它们的蛋通常没人吃，但人类想吃的话，也不是不能吃。

lines.en: This is pointless.
lines.zh: 这毫无意义。

lines.en: No one ever cares that I am a marsh warbler.
lines.zh: 从来没人在乎我是一只湿地苇莺。

lines.en: No one ever cares that I am not the real me.
lines.zh: 从来没人在乎我不是真正的我。

lines.en: I am just a player in a game.
lines.zh: 我只是一场游戏里的玩家。

lines.en: A game with both limited and unlimited possibilities, that will never truly end until I have decided that I have either won or lost.
lines.zh: 一场可能性既有限又无限的游戏，直到我亲自判定输赢，它都不会真正结束。

lines.en: I have so much more to do.
lines.zh: 我还有那么多事要做。

lines.en: So many birds I have to be.
lines.zh: 有那么多只鸟，等我去当。

lines.en: So many cloacae I need to poke at with my beak.
lines.zh: 有那么多泄殖腔，等我的喙去戳。

lines.en: And yet I stand here under a vent blasting out cold air and shrinking my scrotum, remembering what it is like to be alone.
lines.zh: 可我却站在这里，头顶的通风口呼呼吹着冷气、冻缩着我的蛋蛋，回味着孤独的滋味。

lines.en: Being surrounded by familiar faces means absolutely nothing when all of those faces are warped into the shapes I most want them to resemble.
lines.zh: 当身边所有熟悉的面孔，全都被扭曲成我最想要的样子，被人包围就再没有任何意义。

lines.en: This combination of cloth standing before me is the closest I have come to feeling whole since this life began.
lines.zh: 眼前这团布料的组合，是这一世开始以来，我最接近「完整」的一次。

lines.en: I can not win.
lines.zh: 我赢不了。

lines.en: I can only lose.
lines.zh: 我只会输。

lines.en: I feel like I am going to be sick.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己快要吐了。

lines.en: I want to wear the dress and look at myself in the mirror.
lines.zh: 我想穿上那条裙子，看着镜子里的自己。

lines.en: I want to feel it again.
lines.zh: 我想再感受一次。

"I cannot see what flowers are at my feet,\n
Nor what soft incense hangs upon the boughs,"
"But, in embalmed darkness, guess each sweet\n
Wherewith the seasonable month endows"
"The grass, the thicket, and the fruit-tree wild;\n
White hawthorn, and the pastoral eglantine;"
"Fast fading violets cover'd up in leaves;\n
And mid-May's eldest child,"
"The coming musk-rose, full of dewy wine,\n
The murmurous haunt of flies on summer eves."
Do I wake or sleep?
lines.zh: 我究竟是醒着，还是睡着？

"My heart aches, and a drowsy numbness pains\n
My sense, as though of hemlock I had drunk,"
"Or emptied some dull opiate to the drains\n
One minute past, and Lethe-wards had sunk:"
"'Tis not through envy of thy happy lot,\n
But being too happy in thine happiness,—"
"That thou, light-winged Dryad of the trees\n
In some melodious plot"
"Of beechen green, and shadows numberless,\n
Singest of summer in full-throated ease."
: Close your eyes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : When you wake up, I’ll be right here.
lines.zh: : 醒来的时候，我就在这里。

lines.en: : And the two of us will go out together.

lines.en: : I’ll cry...and you’ll stand tall.
lines.zh: : 我会哭……而你会挺立。

lines.en: : And when tomorrow comes, it will be like none of this ever happened.

lines.en: : We’ll forget together.
